mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines in the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not negative in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and a drop in consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates weakening household demand and financial stress, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not negative in >60% of instances where HOUST declines and RSAFS drops simultaneously, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, the supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output signal an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not negative in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over the prior quarter signals strong aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive in >60% of instances where GDPC1 increases in the prior quarter, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not negative in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tight labor market and restrictive monetary policy, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not negative in >60% of instances where UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high consumer credit growth (RSAFS > 2.0% MoM), the strong household spending drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not positive in >60% of instances where RSAFS MoM > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
